claim_scope: CPU-only full-401 diagnostic on 10 fixed Marmousi records from the train split; every record was later consumed by full-data pretraining, so this is seen-data optimization evidence and not a generalization, validation, test_id, or target claim
hypothesis: The immutable update-13300 pyramid-MoE checkpoint has lower mean full-401 relative L2 than the frozen WFP parent on all 10 registered Marmousi confirmation-role train records.
expected_mechanism: Full-data direct coefficient supervision should reduce modeled low-frequency reconstruction error while the unchanged unmodeled spectral tail supplies the same irreducible contribution to candidate and parent metrics.
primary_metric: candidate_mean full-401 relative L2 versus parent_mean on all 10 registered Marmousi records
failure_signal: Reject the diagnostic on binding drift, non-finite output, incomplete record coverage, process failure, or any validation/test_id access.
rollback: The active four-GPU pretraining process and all existing checkpoints remain untouched. Preserve the immutable candidate snapshot and write evaluation-only artifacts under this versioned directory.
